svg.title: Dual PZEM EV charger bench wiring
svg.desc: 120 VAC feed into Wago L, N and ground buses; each relay switches its outlet hot, which passes through a solid-core CT; both PZEM-004T V4 modules take fused L and N on terminals 1 and 2 and CT leads on 3 and 4; low-voltage side runs on breadboard rails from an HLK-PM01, with both PZEMs sharing one UART to the ESP32 and an I2C LCD behind a 3.3 V to 5 V level shifter.
